as_told.title: Kandahar giant body loaded at Bagram

plain: A giant said to have been captured in Afghanistan was later loaded onto a cargo pallet, and a cargo pilot who saw it says the first thing that hit him was a smell like body odor and death. According to the pilot, the being had red hair, pale white skin, six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot. The filmmaker and researcher Tim Alberino relays this account, which he heard secondhand. In another version he puts the loading at Bagram Airfield in 2005 and credits the author Steve Quayle and Quayle's book True Legends.
